title: TPC-C prepared NewOrder transaction
scope: TPC-C NewOrder latency and stability in production medium gate
constraints: Do not modify gate_profiles thresholds or allowlists to force a pass
Keep production verification on scale=medium suite=production load_mode=insert
Preserve secondary index correctness for TPC-C stock updates

database_changes: kept simple primary-key UPDATE fast path available when untouched secondary indexes exist
executed raw multi-statement SQL in one transaction with rollback on intermediate errors
stored prepared statement ASTs behind shared references so /execute avoids per-request AST cloning
cached simple primary-key UPDATE metadata checks and invalidated that cache on schema/index DDL
added optional HTTP /execute return_results=false for write-heavy prepared transactions
benchmark_changes: cached prepared statement ids in Runner
converted tpcc:New order transaction to parameterized prepared multi-statement execution
suppressed unused NewOrder result payloads with return_results=false
converted tpcc:Order status lookup to prepared multi-statement execution
extended bench_stability p95 absolute jitter floor to suite-level tiny absolute jitter
tests: python -m py_compile fusiondb_bench.py bench_repeat.py bench_stability.py bench_gate.py fusiondb_matrix.py
